single_variable: form of the within-target ranking term at fixed weight 0.5: ranknet -> regression-compatible ListCE; the incumbent already carried RankNet at that weight, so it is the matched misaligned control

A0repro.note: same configuration retrained here; the run-to-run control

O1.requirement: k=0 ordering floor / r beats A0 with a positive component lower bound
O1.measured: floor 0.6931 worse than A0repro 0.6850 and A0frozen 0.6922; r 0.186 < 0.213; interval crosses zero

O4.requirement: R1 r exceeds R3 (necessity) with a positive lower bound
O4.measured: floor 0.6931 vs 0.6951 (delta 0.002); r 0.186 vs 0.178; both inside the same-config noise band

measured_cause.claim: the regression-compatible ListCE is inert by construction at this model's operating point
measured_cause.mechanism: the gradient scales as 1/T(p); the same factor that makes the term stationary at T(p) proportional to w damps it everywhere else, worst where predictions are under-dispersed and T(p) is nearly constant across the panel
measured_cause.general_lesson: exact regression-compatibility and useful ranking pressure are in tension; the pre-implementation alignment check probed only s=y and could not expose this

secondary_finding.claim: the k=0 Pareto frontier is close to same-configuration retraining noise
secondary_finding.evidence: A0repro vs A0frozen, identical configuration and seeds, differ by 0.058 k=0 MSE (2.0911 vs 2.1488) and 0.051 in r (0.162 vs 0.213); the whole frontier spread A0->B3 is 0.094, only 1.6x that
secondary_finding.consequence: A0frozen's recorded 2.149 is one draw, not a constant; no frontier MSE difference was ever resolved by a component bootstrap

closed: the loss-form axis for this family. R9 (cliff dose), R10 (variance), R12 (margin form) and R14 (regression-compatible listwise) each varied the within-target ranking objective; none moved the ordering floor
not_tested: a larger ListCE weight, or a shift closer to the label range. The shift was fixed at 2.0 pK in advance and the preregistration forbade a post-hoc sweep; reopening needs its own preregistration and starts from a weak prior
next_hypothesis: r is bounded by what the ligand representation carries about within-target potency ordering, not by the objective; the next step is a representation-side diagnostic (meta_train-only fit on frozen trunk embeddings), not a model change
